maddeler.e:
تحشرجت (form IIq)
# تَحَشْرَجْتُ (taḥašrajtu) /ta.ħaʃ.rad͡ʒ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَشْرَجَ (taḥašraja)
# تَحَشْرَجْتَ (taḥašrajta) /ta.ħaʃ.rad͡ʒ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَشْرَجَ (taḥašraja)
# تَحَشْرَجْتِ (taḥašrajti) /ta.ħaʃ.rad͡ʒ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَشْرَجَ (taḥašraja)
# تَحَشْرَجَتْ (taḥašrajat) /ta.ħaʃ.ra.d
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
